prompt: The LED chaser runs up the strip once and then all LEDs stay off; there is no fault. Find the root cause.
rootCause: led_port_value_max = 1 << led_port_bit_length is one bit too wide: the mask 0x400 exceeds MAX_LED_MASK, set_led_port rejects it (returns 1) and the LEDs never update again. No fault — a breakpoint on set_led_port's early return shows it.
